component.name: Big Recorder
component.summary: Record and edit voice notes locally

description.p: Big Recorder records microphone audio locally with a modern GTK interface. It is designed for quick voice notes, recording sessions, and basic local audio editing without uploading audio to an external service.

ul.li: Record microphone audio to WAV files.
Pause, resume, and stop recording sessions.
Play saved recordings inside the app.
Trim, adjust volume, change speed, change pitch, equalize, reverse, merge, and export recordings.
Save recordings in the user's Music directory under BigRecorder.
